name: Vansen ChemGuard Nitrile Gauntlet Pro
description:
Elbow-length chemical-resistant gauntlets in matte industrial yellow, molded from layered nitrile-analog compound over a knitted fiber substrate. The exterior is smooth and seamless from fingertip to mid-forearm, then transitions to a textured grip band before the flared cuff. A Vansen compliance stamp is embossed at the wrist — required for certified chemical handling in GLMZ regulatory zones.

The inner lining is moisture-wicking and replaceable via a rolled-cuff inversion system. Finger articulation is stiff but adequate. Standard issue across Tier 2 chemical processing plants, often found in Tier 1 black-market lots missing the compliance stamp.
functionality: Resists acids, alkalis, solvents, and biological reagents at standard industrial concentrations. Rolled-cuff design prevents liquid ingress. Replaceable liner extends gauntlet service life. Not rated for electrical hazard.
what_it_says: You follow safety protocols — or at least you're supposed to.
worn_by: the Gray Zone scavengers handling unknown substances
story_hooks: A shipment of Vansen gauntlets arrives at a the Gray Zone clinic — inside one pair, rolled tight in the liner, is a data chip wrapped in oilcloth.
A Tier 2 worker is found unconscious; their Vansen gauntlets show signs of chemical exposure from a compound not used in their assigned facility.

physical_description.visual_profile: Industrial-utilitarian elbow-length gauntlets with a bold matte yellow exterior that commands attention on the wrist and forearm. The silhouette is slightly oversized and rigid, projecting authority and technical competence. Worn primarily by chemical handlers and hazmat specialists across the GLMZ.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit from fingertip through mid-forearm, then deliberately relaxed at the flared cuff to accommodate layered undergarments or augmentation ports. Finger articulation is stiff and deliberate—designed for precision gripping rather than dexterity.
physical_description.primary_material: Layered nitrile-analog compound (synthetic polymer blend) bonded over a moisture-wicking knitted fiber substrate. High chemical and thermal resistance rated for industrial GLMZ compliance zones.
physical_description.texture: Exterior is smooth and seamless from fingertip to mid-forearm, transitioning to a pronounced textured grip band at the wrist before the rolled-cuff edge. Interior lining is soft, perforated weave with visible moisture-management channels.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte industrial yellow (high-visibility standard) with embossed gray compliance stamp at the wrist. Minimal pattern—function-first design with no decorative elements.
physical_description.closures: No closures—gauntlets slip on. Secured via friction fit and the rolled-cuff inversion system that anchors the moisture-wicking liner to the hand.
distinctive_features: Embossed Vansen compliance stamp at wrist (GLMZ regulatory requirement)
Replaceable inner lining via inversion-cuff system
Textured grip band for chemical-resistant handling
Seamless exterior construction reducing contamination vectors
Flared cuff design for augmentation-port accessibility
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 standard-issue; Tier 1 black-market variants with removed compliance stamps
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate chemical handler, hazmat specialist, or unlicensed industrial worker. Wearing these signals either licensed corporate employment or illegal black-market chemical work. Compliance stamp presence is a legal marker.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new with visible embossed branding; becomes stained and slightly discolored with chemical exposure over weeks of use. Worn units often show faded yellow and cracked texture at the grip band. Illegally modified versions have the compliance stamp abraded or laser-removed.
